title: What Digital Twin Processors Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Digital twin processors are chips architected to run live digital twins: they ingest sensor streams, update physics-based models in real time, and predict what happens next — a processor whose job is keeping a virtual copy of reality synchronized. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Digital Twin Processors: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Digital Twin Processors in one line: Digital twin processors are chips architected to run live digital twins: they ingest sensor streams, update physics-based models in real time, and predict what happens next — a processor whose job is keeping a virtual copy of reality synchronized.
Why it matters: Real-time twins of factories, cities, and bodies need compute that thinks in models, not just data..
Where it is used: smart factories, city operations, personalized medicine, aerospace, energy grids..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
